name: sabo-platform
description: SABO Dairy Platform — Fullstack Monorepo (Next.js Frontend + Vite React Admin + NestJS Backend)

scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix backend & npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix admin
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix admin && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend

author: SABO Team
